title: LUKS2 disk encryption at rest
summary: Encrypts a persistent block device with LUKS2 so data at rest remains unreadable without an authorized key slot.

device_path.description: Target block device or partition encrypted with LUKS2.

cipher.description: Symmetric cipher specification recorded in the LUKS2 header.

requirement.title: LUKS2 disk encryption for {{device_path}}
requirement.statement: While persistent data is stored on {{device_path}}, the storage subsystem shall encrypt the volume with LUKS2 mapped at {{mapper_name}} using cipher {{cipher}} and key-slot policy {{key_slot_policy}}.
requirement.rationale: Prevents offline disclosure or tampering of data at rest on {{device_path}} if storage media is removed or accessed without an unlocked key slot.

preconditions: Target device {{device_path}} is provisioned and initialized with a LUKS2 header.
Cipher {{cipher}} and key-slot policy {{key_slot_policy}} are configured.
positive_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Inspect the LUKS2 header on {{device_path}}, unlock the volume to {{mapper_name}} using an enrolled credential under {{key_slot_policy}}, and verify active dm-crypt mapping.
positive_case.expected_result: LUKS2 header on {{device_path}} reports version 2 with cipher {{cipher}}, active key slots match {{key_slot_policy}}, and /dev/mapper/{{mapper_name}} is active for read-write mount.
positive_case.observable_evidence: cryptsetup luksDump {{device_path}} output confirming LUKS2 and {{cipher}}, plus dmsetup status {{mapper_name}} reporting an active crypt target.
positive_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff luksDump confirms LUKS2 with {{cipher}} and {{key_slot_policy}}, and {{mapper_name}} unlocks and reports an active crypt mapping; FAIL otherwise.
positive_case.negative_or_failure_case: Paired negative case: unlocking {{device_path}} with an unauthorized credential or mounting the raw unencrypted block device fails closed.
positive_case.oracle_source: Linux dm-crypt and LUKS2 on-disk header specification and cryptsetup luksDump / dmsetup status interface contracts.

preconditions: Target device {{device_path}} is locked and /dev/mapper/{{mapper_name}} is absent.
negative_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Attempt to unlock {{device_path}} into {{mapper_name}} using an invalid passphrase/key, and attempt to mount {{device_path}} directly without unlocking LUKS.
negative_case.expected_result: Both unlock with an invalid credential and direct raw mount of {{device_path}} fail; /dev/mapper/{{mapper_name}} is not created and plaintext filesystem metadata is unreadable.
negative_case.observable_evidence: Non-zero exit status and key-rejection error from cryptsetup open on {{device_path}}, absent /dev/mapper/{{mapper_name}}, and failed direct mount.
negative_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff invalid unlock and direct raw mount both fail and {{mapper_name}} remains absent; FAIL if any unauthorized unlock or plaintext read succeeds.
negative_case.negative_or_failure_case: Fails if {{device_path}} accepts an invalid credential, falls back to unencrypted mount, or exposes unencrypted filesystem signatures.
negative_case.oracle_source: Linux dm-crypt / LUKS2 key-slot authentication specification and mount(2) filesystem signature refusal behavior.
